prose: Dan Shukis is the host of an excellent astrology and metaphysics podcast called Cosmic Keys. For his second visit, we spoke about the Great Conjunction of Saturn and Jupiter in Aquarius on 12/21/2020, as we each make the choice between Saturnian enslavement or Uranian freedom.
ext: Dan tells us the story of leaving Chicago, the astrology of 2021, the terraforming of the nature fractal through modified genes, and using magic to open our road from rock bottom.
